svg.title: PostgreSQL snapshot recovery and its limits
svg.desc: The deployed database pattern is plain PostgreSQL with PGDATA and WAL on one PVC, restored through Kopiur. Point-in-time recovery and database failover would require a separate design review; CNPG is retired.
